d: What Anthropic's Oct. 16 research post measures between US adults and its own staff: 39% versus 91% expect AI to make a top-prize scientific discovery by 2030
What a document carries at the top
n: A gate is one step in a quantum circuit, and fewer steps means a program that can run on smaller machines sooner. Anthropic's Oct. 16 post says Claude proposed a design, got a score from a checker program, and tried again with no person between rounds, and the loop beat the best published circuits on eight tasks. The same day its survey put the public at 39% and its own staff at 91% on whether AI makes a top-prize discovery by 2030. When a tool makes a claim, ask who scored it, and notice how far your own expectations sit from the people who built it.
